`svelte/internal` and the modules below it are not public. Svelte 6 removes them, and they change without notice before that. The rule reports imports, re-exports and `import()` of them in components.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-svelte-internal": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<script>
  import { noop } from "svelte/internal";
</script>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<script>
  import { onMount } from "svelte";
</script>
```
